name: Fonderie Impériale
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production battlefield background for the existing game Infernal City. Input reference is CAMERA, surface detail and painterly game-rendering style only; do not copy its dark palette. Create ONE seamless-looking complete landscape battlefield scene, 3:2 image. Subject: an imperial brass foundry esplanade, enormous copper pistons and wrought-iron balconies at the perimeter, glowing but restrained furnaces beyond the edges, clear central riveted steel floor with brass seams and traces of purple velvet banners far outside. Respect this exact visual domain: Steampunk Impérial, Cuivre, Laiton, Velours Pourpre & Vapeur Dorée. Palette: {"bg":"#27121b","primary":"#d97706","secondary":"#fbbf24","glow":"#881337"}. Elevated nearly top-down orthographic 2.5D camera, no horizon or perspective vanishing point; match the reference's game-ready detailed surfaces. The central 65 percent of the image must be a calm empty unobstructed continuous walkable surface so the game can place its own characters, defense rings and citadel. Put tall architecture, spectacle and decoration in the outer 15 percent border only. Four subtle broad approach directions meet an empty central area; no painted obstacles crossing them. Elaborate illustrated materials and lighting, polished cyber-gothic dark fantasy game art, high resolution, no vector clip art. No characters, enemies, towers, weapons, central citadel, UI, text, lettering, labels, grids or watermark. Entire image opaque, no transparency. This is a FIRST original design following the written DLC brief, not a copied design.
